selectionRule: Select exactly the highest candidate score strictly above 50%; ties use inventory order. Otherwise stop as inconclusive.

sourceAudit.reverseFutility: quiet, non-root, unrepeated; depth <= 4; se - 120 * depth >= beta
sourceAudit.razoring: quiet, non-root, unrepeated; depth <= 2; margins depth1=350, depth2=550; confirm with null-window qsearch
sourceAudit.nullMove: quiet, non-root, unrepeated; depth >= 3; R=2 at depth 3-5, R=3 at depth >=6; nullOk, inactivity, mate-window and se>=beta guards retained
sourceAudit.probCut: capture, non-root, unrepeated; depth >= 5; pcBeta=beta+200 capped below mate; pcDepth=depth-4; top 3 captures
sourceAudit.lmp: quiet, non-single moves; depth <= 2; depth1 threshold=6, depth2 threshold=10; valid alpha guard
